As far as I can tell, the windows photo app doesn't use any special folder or storage format. By default it looks for image files in "C:\Users<username>\Pictures" and "C:\Users<username>\OneDrive\Photos".

You can check the list of folders under "Settings->Sources"

You can change the default program by right clicking a picture, then properties and there should be a "Opens with".
